verdict.rationale: The README explicitly advertises CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than total VRAM (gh-10). Community users corroborate it: one describes GPU/CPU model splitting that lets 70B models run on desktops (comm-11), and another reports tuning N_GPU_LAYERS for partial offload (comm-9). One report notes only modest speedups in early versions (comm-10), a performance caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of offload configuration (layer and tensor-split controls), and current benchmarks quantifying hybrid-offload performance.
